The keyhole and latch are around 1 metre above the floor and noticeably BELOW the viewer's eye line. Show the full doorway, a little wall above the lintel, and a modest strip of receding floor; no huge foreground pebbles or close floor texture. Use a normal 45mm-equivalent lens with straight verticals and modest depth, no ultrawide distortion, no upward heroic camera, no crouched viewpoint, no dollhouse or bird's-eye view. Preserve the old closed timber door, weathered iron straps and hinges, rough stone passage, tactile illustrated material, amber light from left and cool shadow.
